narration.text: I tested 30 AI tools for TikTok. Only 5 are truly useful.
At number 5, Opus Clip. This tool repurposes your long videos into short, viral clips for TikTok. It saves so much time creating multiple pieces of content from one source.
Coming in at number 4, ElevenLabs. It generates incredibly realistic voiceovers for your TikToks. The voice quality is so natural, your audience won't believe it's AI generated.
Number 3 is Captions. This app automatically adds dynamic, engaging captions to your videos. It makes your content more accessible and holds viewer attention effectively.
The runner-up at number 2 is Copy.ai. This AI brainstorms viral script ideas in minutes. It helps you overcome writer's block and keeps your content fresh and trending.
And the top spot goes to Descript. It edits video by simply editing text, even removing filler words. This is a game changer for quick, professional TikTok edits.
Descript is the undisputed champion for TikTok creators. Which AI tool do you use for TikTok?
